87 * 6 jaldi kaise nikale?

87 * 6 jaldi nikalne ki trick: 87 ko 90 - 3 samjho.

90 * 6 = 540, aur 3 * 6 = 18.

540 - 18 = 522. To 87 * 6 = 522.

200 ka 25% nikalne ke liye: 200 * 25 / 100 = 50. Matlab 200 ka 25% = 50 hota hai. Shortcut: 25% matlab ek-chauthai, aur 200 ka ek-chauthai 50 hai.
